==Results==
The following lists the match results for ''Saturday Night's Main Event''{{'}}s televised shows, and do not include results for any of the 2022 house shows.

===1980s===
====Saturday Night's Main Event I====
{{Main|Saturday Night's Main Event I}}
'''Saturday Night's Main Event I''' took place May 10, 1985, from [[Uniondale, New York]], in [[Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum]], and aired May 11, 1985, this was the first event for the Superstars that would be escorted to the ring by the host city's [[list of largest local police departments in the United States|local police]] and since 1985, this has become a main staple for SNME.<ref name=snme1>{{cite web|title=Saturday Night's Main Event: May 10, 1985|publisher=World Wrestling Entertainment|url=http://www.wwe.com/shows/snme/history/1985to1992/may111985|access-date=2007-10-05|archive-date=March 29, 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080329070003/http://www.wwe.com/shows/snme/history/1985to1992/may111985|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name=WWF6389Book>{{cite book | first=Graham | last=Cawthon | title=the History of Professional Wrestling|volume=1: WWF 1963–1989 | publisher=CreateSpace Independent Publishing Platform | year= 2013 | isbn=978-1492825975}}</ref> The event aired on [[NBC]] and drew an 8.8 rating.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cagematch.net/?id=1&nr=2985|title=WWF Saturday Night's Main Event #1 « Events Database « CAGEMATCH - The Internet Wrestling Database|website=www.cagematch.net|access-date=2019-09-17|archive-date=October 6, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201006053358/https://www.cagematch.net/?id=1&nr=2985|url-status=live}}</ref>

====Saturday Night's Main Event II====
{{Infobox Wrestling event
|name = Saturday Night's Main Event II
|promotion = [[World Wrestling Federation]]
|date = October 3, 1985
|date_aired = October 5, 1985
|city = [[East Rutherford, New Jersey]]
|venue = [[Brendan Byrne Arena]]
|attendance = 8,000<ref name=snme85 />
|event      = ''Saturday Night's Main Event''
|lastevent2 = [[Saturday Night's Main Event I|I]]
|nextevent2 = [[Saturday Night's Main Event III|III]]
}}
'''Saturday Night's Main Event II''' took place on October 3, 1985, from [[East Rutherford, New Jersey]], at the [[Brendan Byrne Arena]], and aired on October 5, 1985.<ref name=WWF6389Book/><ref name=snme2>{{cite web|title=Saturday Night's Main Event: October 3, 1985|publisher=World Wrestling Entertainment|url=http://www.wwe.com/shows/snme/history/1985to1992/oct051985|access-date=2007-10-05|archive-date=February 21, 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080221200020/http://www.wwe.com/shows/snme/history/1985to1992/oct051985|url-status=live}}</ref> The event aired on [[NBC]] and drew an 8.3 rating.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cagematch.net/?id=1&nr=2986|title=WWF Saturday Night's Main Event #2 « Events Database « CAGEMATCH - The Internet Wrestling Database|website=www.cagematch.net|access-date=2019-09-17|archive-date=October 5, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201005023835/https://www.cagematch.net/?id=1&nr=2986|url-status=live}}</ref>

During the broadcast, [[Uncle Elmer]] was [[Legit (professional wrestling)|legitimately]] married to Joyce Stazko.

====Saturday Night's Main Event III====
{{Infobox Wrestling event
|name = Saturday Night's Main Event III
|promotion = [[World Wrestling Federation]]
|date = October 31, 1985
|date_aired = November 2, 1985
|city = [[Hershey, Pennsylvania]]
|venue = [[Hersheypark Arena]]
|attendance = 8,000<ref name=snme85 />
|event      = ''Saturday Night's Main Event''
|lastevent2 = [[Saturday Night's Main Event II|II]]
|nextevent2 = [[Saturday Night's Main Event IV|IV]]
}}
'''Saturday Night's Main Event III''' took place on October 31, 1985, from [[Hershey, Pennsylvania]], at the [[Hersheypark Arena]], and aired on November 2, 1985.<ref name=WWF6389Book/><ref>{{cite web | access-date=May 17, 2015 | publisher=WWE | url=http://www.wwe.com/shows/snme/history/1985to1992/nov021985 | title=Saturday Night Main Event – Nov. 2, 1985 | archive-date=March 24, 2012 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120324105654/http://www.wwe.com/shows/snme/history/1985to1992/nov021985 | url-status=live }}</ref> The event aired on [[NBC]] and drew a 6.3 rating.<ref name="snme85" />

|time3 = 4:08
|match4 = [[Ricky Steamboat]] defeated [[Mr. Fuji]] (with [[The Magnificent Muraco]])

====Saturday Night's Main Event IV====
{{Infobox Wrestling event
|name = Saturday Night's Main Event IV
|promotion = [[World Wrestling Federation]]
|date = December 19, 1985
|date_aired = January 4, 1986
|city = [[Tampa, Florida]]
|venue = [[USF Sun Dome]]
|attendance =
|event      = ''Saturday Night's Main Event''
|lastevent2 = [[Saturday Night's Main Event III|III]]
|nextevent2 = [[Saturday Night's Main Event V|V]]
}}
'''Saturday Night's Main Event IV''' took place on December 19, 1985, from [[Tampa, Florida]], at the [[USF Sun Dome]], and aired on January 4, 1986.<ref name=WWF6389Book/><ref>{{cite web | access-date=May 17, 2015 | publisher=WWE | url=http://www.wwe.com/shows/snme/history/1985to1992/jan041986 | title=Saturday Night Main Event – Jan. 4, 1986 | archive-date=March 31, 2008 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080331193445/http://www.wwe.com/shows/snme/history/1985to1992/jan041986 | url-status=live }}</ref> The event aired on [[NBC]] and drew a 10.4 rating.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cagematch.net/?id=1&nr=3212|title=WWF Saturday Night's Main Event #4 « Events Database « CAGEMATCH - The Internet Wrestling Database|website=www.cagematch.net|access-date=2019-09-17|archive-date=October 6, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201006210709/https://www.cagematch.net/?id=1&nr=3212|url-status=live}}</ref>
